impact_narrative: Roughly 6% of purchase attempts are being rejected for a price mismatch, against a baseline of about 1,200 checkout requests per minute.
cause_summary: Commit 02c238690b enabled the dynamic pricing engine and recomputes the price at charge time, so quotes and charges disagree. A revert (8957606ede) is merged on main but has not been deployed, so production is still running the bad code.

runbook_citation.heading_path: Checkout Service Runbook > High error rate after a deploy
runbook_citation.why: The fix is a deploy rollback of the checkout release containing the pricing change.

next_steps: Deploy the existing revert 8957606ede, or roll back the checkout deploy containing 02c238690b.
Confirm the payment failure rate returns below 0.5% on the Checkout Overview dashboard.
Re-land dynamic pricing with the quote price carried through to the charge.
